note: Copy to github.json. Set github_corp.url to your GitHub Enterprise URL. Leave orgs empty to scan all accessible repos.
note_pending_review_staging: OFF by default (ADR-0007): the default review path writes local Markdown artifacts to output/github-reviews/ and makes NO GitHub API writes. Set pending_review_staging.enabled=true PER INSTANCE to opt in to staging a native GitHub PENDING review (body-only, invisible until you click Submit review — never submitted/approved/changes-requested). When enabled, 'repos' is an allowlist: list repo names ('web-frontend') or 'owner/repo' ('octo-org/web-frontend') to stage only those. An EMPTY 'repos' array with enabled=true stages for ALL detected review-request repos on that instance. If staging fails (auth/VPN/API error), the local artifact is preserved as the fallback.
